text: Zelle is deeply embedded with Zelle Tags, split/multi-contact requests, contact sync and a dedicated small-business variant; instant limits raised to $2,500/day and $10,000/month in 2026 [S009, S010]
Free next-day external transfers in both directions and an inbound 'within minutes' option defined in the June 2026 terms [S009, S012]
2025–2026 app cadence delivered SMB domestic wires with saved recipients, wire activity, Disputes Center, in-app direct-deposit switching and mobile-deposit fund-availability estimates [S010]

TD eTreasury is a full-function treasury portal with mandatory dual control on all wires, same-day ACH, real-time FX on international wires, ACH/check positive pay with payee-name verification and mobile approvals [S014, S041, S043]
RTP receive has been live since Nov 2019 with a $100,000 receive cap and no fee [S016, S018]
Static 'Security Reminder' interstitial with mandatory acknowledgment checkbox on every Zelle send, including QR sends; QR path shows the recipient's enrolled name [S910, S912]
Zelle QR scan-to-pay and 'My Code' (share/print) live in the TD app [S905, S912]
External-account linking offers instant credential-based verification with a trial-deposit fallback, in both app and Online Banking [S906, S920]

Small Business Online Banking roles support per-activity approval types (none, single, dual, or deny), batch and daily release limits, transaction limits and approval-needed alerts across ACH, CCD and wires [S924, S934]
Bill Payment Service Guarantee covers up to $50 in late charges [S936]
Digital direct-deposit switch with percentage/dollar/entire-paycheck allocation and real-time status (Aug-Sep 2026) [S919, S928]
TD Digital Academy publishes ~100 interactive step-by-step demos covering every core money-movement flow, refreshed 2024-2026 [S927]
No customer-initiated instant-payment send on RTP or FedNow; RTP send has been 'coming soon' since 2020 [S016, S017]

Consumer international wires are in-person only and there is no U.S. cross-border remittance product (TD Global Transfer is Canada-only); TD's own KB contradicts itself on whether consumers can send domestic wires in Online Banking [S932, S902, S029]
Zelle only available in English even though the app offers Spanish; QR-code availability contradicted on TD's own page [S002, S007]

Help content is loaded client-side (invisible to non-JS crawlers) and parts are stale or contradictory: KB 2215 says the app cannot make external transfers while Academy demos show it can; the KB gives opposite answers on consumer domestic wires; the Zelle-for-business FAQ still says QR is unavailable [S901, S902, S906, S007]

Only a static Security Reminder interstitial (mandatory checkbox); no in-app scam reporting and no published scam-reimbursement policy beyond 'qualifying imposter scams may be eligible'; three different phone numbers for Zelle issues [S910, S007, S006, S913]

Low external-transfer monthly caps ($20,000 combined) and the 2024 OCC consent order, under which new bank products require OCC supervisory approval until the AML program is accepted, constrain the roadmap [S009, S031]
Not a FedNow participant as of the FRB list of 11/02/26 while JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, Citi, PNC and Capital One are [S929]
Scam intake is phone-only: online dispute flow covers posted debit-card transactions only, and the Help Center has no Zelle scam answer [S904, S917]

Help content is stale/contradictory: KB says external transfers are Online Banking-only (app demos show otherwise) and gives opposite answers on whether consumer domestic wires can be sent online [S902, S906]
Consumer international wires require a branch appointment [S932]
Account-number recipients inside the Zelle flow route to a separate 1-3 business-day ACH service, disclosed only in small print [S921]
Zelle Security Reminder is static, not risk-based; no scam warning on external transfers [S910, S906]
Biller maintenance is desktop-only and submitted disputes can only be changed by phone/branch [S903, S904]
eBill disputes have no in-product path: the agreement pushes all eBill discrepancies to the biller, and AutoPay must be cancelled manually before processing [S970]
TD Embedded Banking page still carries the stale footnote 'Availability of wires through ERP expected Summer 2024' in Nov 2026 [S981]
Mandatory dual control for every eTreasury wire (not configurable) [S014]
TD Embedded Banking: ACH/wire/check initiation and Positive Pay files directly inside NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online and Dynamics 365 BC [S042]
TD Early Pay available on all personal checking and savings accounts with automatic enrollment [S034]
Small-business payment acceptance bundled via Autobooks (TD Online Accounting) and Tap to Pay on iPhone inside the consumer app [S045]
Zelle 'Send Money' hub bundles a TD-proprietary account-number P2P service alongside Zelle tokens [S921]

Oct 2024: OCC/FinCEN/DOJ BSA-AML consent orders; $450M OCC CMP (part of ~US$3.09B total); asset cap at US$434B; OCC supervisory approval required for new products, services, markets and stores until the improved AML program is accepted; remediation milestones run through 2027 [S028, S031]
Nov 2025 (app 26.1.1, Nov 5): small-business customers can send domestic wires and save/manage recipients in the TD Bank app [S928]
Jul 2025 (25.09): Bill Pay status shown on account activity page; Jun 2025 (25.08): check images in transaction details [S010]
Jan 2026 (26.3.2, Jan 25): fund-availability estimates for mobile check deposits [S928]
Apr–May 2026 (26.5–26.6): wire transfer activity view for small business; Tap2Pay enhancements [S010]
May–Jun 2026 (26.7–26.8): Disputes Center for tracking disputes in app [S010]
Jul–Sep 2026 (26.9–26.10): Zelle instant limits increased to $2,500 daily / $10,000 monthly; linked-services (third-party app access) management [S010]
Sep 2026 (26.11): direct deposit setup/switching in app [S010, S034]
Jun 16 2026: new External Transfer and Zelle Payment Services Terms defining 'Instant Transfers', Zelle Tags and Zelle Small Business Service [S009]

Corrected app-version dating from App Store history: Check images in transaction details 25.09 (2025-07-16); Bill Pay status on activity 25.10.1 (2025-08-20); Bill Pay transition updates 25.11 (2025-09-16); Payment Center redesign 25.11/25.12 (Sep-Oct 2025); SMB domestic wires + saved recipients 26.1.1 (2025-11-05); 24 months of transactions 26.3 (2026-01-14); mobile-deposit fund-availability estimates 26.3.2 (2026-01-25); Spanish language preference 26.4.5 (2026-02-24); SMB wire activity 26.6.1 (2026-04-22); Disputes Center 26.7.3 (2026-06-02); Zelle limits $2,500/$10,000 26.10.1 (2026-08-05); linked third-party services management 26.10.1 (2026-08-05); direct deposit in app 26.11.0 (2026-09-16); Balance Transfer status tracking 26.12 (2026-10-22) [S928]
Jul 2026: Academy published SMB demos for wire and ACH enrollment and role-based approvals; Jul 2026 debit-card dispute demo; Aug 2026 digital direct deposit demo [S922, S923, S924, S917, S919]

Sep-Oct 2025 (app 25.11 Sep 16, 25.11.2 Sep 28, 25.12 Oct 22): release notes cite 'Updated features that allow seamless transitions while using Bill Pay' and a redesigned Payment Center; nature of the transition not disclosed [S928]
Whether 'Instant Transfers' in the June 2026 terms are live in the UI and which network (RTP, FedNow or card) they use
Same-day ACH availability for small business online banking (confirmed only for eTreasury)
RTP Request for Payment support
Can consumers actually send domestic wires in Online Banking (KB 2624) or only in store (KB 1398)? Requires logged-in check
Which TD UI surfaces expose 'Instant Transfers' and at what fee (contents of the 'Fees and delivery info' table)
Does the Zelle Security Reminder vary by payee/risk, and is there any warning on first-time account-number P2P recipients?
Step-by-step SMB in-app domestic wire send flow and pending-approval expiry
Has TD Embedded Banking's ERP wire initiation launched? (TD page still footnotes 'expected Summer 2024' in 2026) [TD-C015, UNRESOLVED]
Did the Sep-Oct 2025 'Bill Pay transition' app releases reflect a Bill Pay platform or vendor migration? [TD-C010]
Which network carries TD's 'Instant Transfers' (terms give ACH and ACCEL/Exchange only as definition examples), and is the option live in the UI? [TD-C012]

TD Business Central U.S. is confirmed as 'TD Bank's commercial digital platform' (live by Oct 2025), but its payment modules (ACH, wires, RTP) and whether it replaced the TD eTreasury login are not public; scope remains login-gated.

What exactly is TD's imposter-scam reimbursement policy? The only text found is 'Qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement' (Zelle for Business page). No criteria, claim flow or consumer-page equivalent was found.

Which network carries the 'Instant Transfers' named in the June 2026 terms, and is the option live in the UI? (S973's 'within minutes' debit-card footnote sits with the Zelle content and is not linked to Instant Transfers.)
Can a TD Zelle requester cancel an outstanding request? No TD text found.
